changes.comment: Open the table subcomponents to their native attributes: THead, TBody, TR, TH and TD accepted only children, so a header cell could not carry scope — the attribute that lets assistive technology associate a data cell with its header — and a cell could not span columns without dropping to a raw element. Each now extends its proper HTML attribute type and spreads, matching how every other primitive in the package already behaves, and TH's docs say why scope is not optional in spirit.
